preview: This episode looks at the different feelings families may have when a husband takes his wife’s last name. What can we learn from people who have faced this family decision in different ways?
comment_1: As you listen, notice what each person says about choosing the wife’s last name.
comment_3: The same choice can feel different to different people. As you listen to the final thoughts, think about why that might be.
